cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(explorer_scalability LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
add_executable(scalability_tests tests.cpp)
target_compile_features(scalability_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(scalability_tests PRIVATE GTest::gtest_main)
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(scalability_tests)
